pages.title: Petalfall Vernal
pages.text: Springs depart and return; petals fall and bloom again. Legend says the Petalfall Vernal was born of the wilderness's final longing for spring: whenever the first spring flower withers, its form blossoms anew. Petals swirl around it in an unending rain of flowers.

pages.title: Traits
pages.text: In the form of Petalfall Vernal, you gain the spring's power of $(thing)nourishment and renewal$(0). Withered things bloom again and wounds heal slowly — just as plants broken by winter always reawaken in the spring breeze.

pages.title: Transformation Recipe
pages.text: Arrange these four offerings on the $(item)Spirit Table$(0), then right-click it holding a $(item)Murmol Soul$(0): $(li)petal$(li)sweet berries$(li)glistering melon slice$(li)apple$(br)Each transformation consumes $(thing)5 XP levels$(0). $(br)Alternatively, craft the $(item)Petalfall Vernal Soul$(0) at a crafting table from an $(item)Ancient Knowledge Scrap (Petalfall Vernal)$(0), a $(item)Murmol Soul$(0) and the four materials above.
